complete_old_immune_decisions.full_chain_observation:
Actual registered chain: @Mod constructor installs setup; ChampionCapability.register installs both event handlers; concrete ShieldingAffix is put into ID/category registry. LivingEntity+Enemy qualification attaches capability. Spawn/JoinWorld without rank installs selected affixes and invokes initial callbacks, but Shielding inherits empty onInitialSpawn/onSpawn. No default active mode or initial sync is implied.
On delivered server LivingUpdate, outer tickCount%10 condition and inner tickCount%40 plus float<0.5 gate invert current side-owned BooleanData. Only successful sample saves mode and requests tracking packet. A failed sample preserves either active or inactive phase; hits never spend shield or alter sampling. There is no deterministic finite active deadline or two-second shield lease in this code.
Delivered server LivingAttack iterates all target affixes. Shielding exact OUT_OF_WORLD reference exception returns true before sound; other attacks when stored mode true submit no-damage sound then return false, causing caller setCanceled(true). No amount>0, attacker owner, per-hit RNG, hit budget, resource debit or source tag predicate. Later true returns cannot undo cancellation, iteration does not short-circuit until after all target affixes; then canceled skips attacker callbacks. Native Forge dispatch of an already-canceled event is not expanded.
BasicAffix sends concrete affix data through registered SPacketSyncAffixData. Codec carries integer entity ID, affix ID and CompoundTag only. Enqueued consumer checks current world/capability/mapped affix and applies readSyncTag/saveData; no UUID/dimension/generation, pending replay or delivery acknowledgment. A handled packet is not proof state applied. Native channel scheduling and world lifetime unexecuted.
Actual StartTracking sends SPacketSyncChampion rank/color/affix names, without mode. Its client consumer installs rank/list; no concrete Shielding callback supplies current state initially. Under fresh empty client data and already-active server state, observer can lack true display until a later toggle; that first successful toggle may be false. This is a conditional source boundary, not live desynchronization reproduced or bounded wait.
Client onLivingUpdate invokes installed affix onClientUpdate before rank showParticles condition. Shielding true local mode requests one white ENTITY_EFFECT at random body position each delivered update. showParticles gate controls later rank particles, not Shielding particles. This state presentation differs from unthrottled per-incoming-attack no-damage sound; neither is a proven target-authenticated refusal receipt or native delivered sensory evidence.
Client.setAffixes clears its list but not idToAffix or data maps. A removed mapped affix can still accept an ID state packet, while no longer in tick list; previously received data need not be fresh default on reused capability. AffixData constructs a data object and reads side map; reflection can return null with unchecked callers. Native CompoundTag missing/wrong-type semantics not expanded; fresh Java boolean field alone is not proof of all decoded tag defaults.
Conversion creates/uses different capability then copies rank/affix references and invokes empty Shielding initial callback; it does not explicitly copy old private data. Save reader hasUUID versus compound mismatch and generic maps remain existing migration owner28be6a, not fresh credit. No guaranteed native reload reset, natural champion spawn, cross-version1.20.1 support or all-affix certification.
complete_old_immune_decisions.concrete_observation: Accept one live stochastic-latched admission/feedback policy. Unlike per-hit random cube/mummy, RNG occurs independently of attacks and correlates all later hits until successful inversion. Unlike Aegis/Undergarden/sharedWildfire, no hit debit/rearm or damage debt. Unlike Gaia/Cat/Wight and cross-target arena schedule, no deterministic phase timer or successful teleport prerequisite. Luna already owns source-category random resampling at its saved countdown; this boolean inversion can retain either phase without any deadline, and initial name-only snapshot omits current mode. Mode sync/particles/per-hit sound are one policy, not separate references. Migration28be6a already owns persistence/conversion/Adaptable memory, all supporting0 here. Identity/keyword screen of473 is not473semantic rereads.
complete_old_immune_decisions.application_to_boss_immune: Boss拒控回执需绑定实际裁决原因；持续防护状态与每次拒绝音效分别管理。初始追踪应带当前状态，增量消息需绑定实体生命周期；不能用客户端粒子有无推断权威免疫，或把随机采样周期当状态持续时长。普通阴阳不新增灰字。只研究，不移植。
complete_old_immune_decisions.limitations:
One stochastic stateful admission/feedback lifecycle at most1. Not one credit each for NBT, packet, source exception, particles, sound, registry, random parameter or side maps.
Shielding is damage attack cancellation, not blanket movement/control/effect immunity. OUT_OF_WORLD identity bypass is local to this affix, not proof every other affix or native gate accepts.
Conditional negative example: server mode already true and a fresh observer receives only the affix-name snapshot. The client has no true mode to display until an applicable later state packet. The next successful inversion is false, so receiving that packet can leave it visually off through the whole unseen true phase. No claim of guaranteed live reproduction or bounded wait.
Client.setAffixes clears the visible list but not idToAffix/data. A previously mapped removed affix can still accept an ID packet and retain data; it is no longer ticked if absent from list. Integer entity ID alone does not authenticate the old actor lifetime. These are contextual limitations, not separate proposals.
Affine data getter reflection can return null on construction error; callers lack null handling. Normal BooleanData missing mode uses native getBoolean behavior, whose implementation was not expanded in this batch.
No shield initial-on state or startup sync inferred from registration; Shielding inherits empty callbacks. No active phase finite upper bound, hit-count limit, authoritative particle receipt or sound delivery guarantee.
Cached branch1.18.x/commit source only. Forge event dispatch, native damage pipeline, tickCount lifecycle, CompoundTag internals, SimpleChannel scheduling and sound/particle transport not expanded. No claim of matching Dynasty1.20.1 API or runtime.
Generic persistence mismatch and conversion remain migration owner28be6a; full helper files read for concrete chain context, not recounted. Other affix implementations, RankManager, EntityManager, GameStages/ScalingHealth and ChampionData deep paths are not certified by imports/calls.

One reference maximum across both modes, source exception, data maps, packets, sound, particles and helpers. Defense is attack cancellation, not control/movement/effect immunity or all-source damage rejection. Sound submitted before outer cancellation does not prove final event, damage denial, exact audible delivery or throttled acknowledgment.
No production Java, art, sharedJar, saved world, process/display, audio/brightness/focus, automation or checklist changes. Applicable1000gate remains unmet; no active-hour claim.
